newsitem.title: INDIA: South Asian port conditions - Lloyds, Sept 17.
newsitem.headline: South Asian port conditions - Lloyds, Sept 17.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

INDIA, Sept 17 - Bombay - Delays expected for container vessels 2-3 days, bulk vessels 7-8 days, general cargo 10-12 days. 12 Vessels loading at berth, 27 discharging at berth, 2 discharging at anchorag. 6 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 20 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 1 Vessel bunkering, 8 vessels under repair, 2 awaiting orders. Occasional rain hampers cargo operations. Calcutta - Four vessels due of which 12 product tankers, 2 coal. 9 Vessels loading at berth, 13 discharging at berth, 1 bunkering. Cochin - Delays expected, fertiliser (rock phosphate/sulphur), steel, grain, coal, sugar up to 1 day. 2 Vessels under repairs/drydock.

Mormugao - Delays expected, molasses 1-2 days, ores 4-5 days. 2 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 3 Vessels under repair/drydock, 1 awaiting orders. Kandla - Delays expected, steel coils, locks, rice, sulphur, copper rivets 10-12 days. 3 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 4 discharging at berth, 7 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 3 Tankers, 20 tankers waiting. Mangalore - Three iron ore concentrate/pellets due with 1-2 days delay expected. Up to 1 day delay for sulphur, general cargo, granite blocks, chemicals. 1 Vessel loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 1 waiting.

Madras - 30 Vessels due of which 5 coal/coke, 5 edible oil, 11 containers, 1 scrap, 7 others, 1 ore. Delays for coal/coke 4-5 days, fertiliser 3-4 days, scrap 5- 6 days, others 3-4 days. 5 Vessels loading at berth, 12 discharging at berth, 19 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Night rain. Jawaharlal Nehru - Five fertiliser/raw material vessels due, 20-22 days delay expected. Tankers/iron ore vessels due, 2-3 days delay expected, 2 vessels discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 4 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Paradip - Five vessels due, 3-4 days delay expected, 5 vessels loading at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to discharge.

Tuticorin - Four vessels due, 1-2 days delay, 5 loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Visakhapatnam - One export granite blocks due, 7-8 days delay expected, 1 vegetable oil due, up to 1 days delay, 1 iron ore due, up to 1 days delay, 1 export billets due, 7-8 days delay, 1 each wire coils, rice, bauxite due, 7-8 days delay, 1 alumina, 1 phosphoric acid due, up to 1 days delay. 3 Vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 5 waiting at anchorage to discharge.

PAKISTAN, Sept 16 - Karachi - One rice vessel loading at berth, 2 container vessels discharging/loading at berth. 11 Vessels discharging at berth (mtb, general cargo, sugar, fertiliser). 1 Rice vessel waiting at anchorage to load. 6 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (containers, fertiliser, fuel oil, sugar, woodpulp). 4 Vessels awaiting orders, 5 due with up to 24 hours delay expected.

SRI LANKA, Sept 17 - Colombo - Seven vessels due, 1 day delay. 2 Breakbulk vessels and 15 containers loading at berth. Discharging at berth, 1 lpg, 2 general cargo, 1 bagged wheat flour, 1 bulk/bagged fertiliser, 1 bagged fertiliser, 15 containers. 8 Containers and 1 sugar waiting at anchorage to discharge. 2 Vessels outside harbour for bunkers, 7 under repair/drydocks, 3 awaiting orders. Galle - No vessels in port. Trincomalee - One vessel discharging aberth, 1 loading at berth.
